extraction.Name: Lizzie D. Sherman
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 480 acre allotment at the time, as she did not want to pay taxes, but the Indian Agency told her that she would have to pay taxes on it finally if she did not take it, so she accepted it
extraction.Buyer: sold the land to H. E. Beebe, of Ipswich, South Dakota, he taking over the mortgage in favor of the Bank of Ipswich, and paying her $400.00 cash over and above the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: In 1920, being behind in taxes, she borrowed $700.00 of the Bank of Ipswich to pay these taxes, giving a mortgage on her place, and giving her notes to cover the loan; she considers that was a pretty poor price for her place, but she was forced to do so under the circumstances
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband supports her; that he farms for a living, and this is the only source of his income
extraction.NOTES: Document No. 3661; 480 acre allotment; made several payments on the loan before selling in 1922; mentally competent, has pretty good health; husband has poor health, being bothered with his lungs and stomach; they find it pretty hard getting along on what they raise; has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; sworn November 23, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
